results.why: K32's core scoring behavior — extent of textual signaling of breadth via many datasets, tasks, models, languages, domains, judged as signaling rather than actual breadth — is the same property T02 scores, though K32 stretches slightly further into resource/infrastructure signals that T02 ignores.

K45 enumerates nearly the same evidence T03 names (large curated data collections, pretraining/full-model training runs, paid annotation panels) and asks the same question — how much resource magnitude the work visibly required, read off what the text describes rather than off importance claims.
